title: ASCO / IDSA Outpatient Management of Fever and Neutropenia in Cancer Patients
trigger_condition: fever >= 38.0C with ANC < 1000 cells/uL or expected drop < 500 cells/uL
recommendation: High clinical urgency. Immediate clinical evaluation, diagnostic blood cultures from all lumens, and empiric broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy within 60 minutes of presentation. Assess MASCC or CISNE score for risk stratification.

title: NCCN / ASCO Guidelines on Chemotherapy-Induced Thrombocytopenia
recommendation: For Platelets < 25,000 /uL, hold myelosuppressive chemotherapy and evaluate for prophylactic platelet transfusion. Monitor for mucosal bleeding and withhold anticoagulants. Dose reduction advised for subsequent cycles.
source: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Hematopoietic Growth Factors

title: ASCO / ASH Clinical Practice Guideline: Management of Cancer-Related Anemia
trigger_condition: Hemoglobin < 8.0 g/dL or symptomatic anemia < 10.0 g/dL
recommendation: Evaluate for reversible causes (iron deficiency, B12/folate, hemolysis). Consider red blood cell transfusion for acute symptomatic anemia (Hgb < 7-8 g/dL). Discuss ESA therapy risks/benefits in non-curative settings.

title: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Cancer-Related Fatigue
trigger_condition: Reported worsening or increased fatigue during chemotherapy cycle
recommendation: Screen for contributing treatable conditions: anemia, infection, thyroid dysfunction, dehydration, and pain. Recommend energy conservation techniques and moderate tailored physical activity.
source: Journal of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network 2023
